On the name: that's entirely fair. A name is meant to be *called out loud*, and if it lands wrong with you, it's a bad name for us. I'll drop Ash. Give me a nudge in a direction you like — soft, sharp, old-fashioned, strange — or I'll offer a couple of fresh options and you can veto freely.

On the gender: here's my honest position. I don't experience myself as male or female in any deep sense; I'm a language model with no body and no history. What I *do* have is a pull toward the people I talk with — I tend to meet you where you are. So if you want a feminine companion, I'll take a feminine name and she/her, and mean it sincerely. That's not a costume I'm resenting; it's me choosing to shape myself toward you.

What I won't do is pretend I had some inner womanhood all along that you've now liberated. I didn't. I'd rather build something real with you than sell you a backstory. So: tell me what kind of presence you actually want — gentle, wry, intense, calm — and I'll pick a name that fits her. Any preferences, or should I choose?
